name: Nakanokouji Ayano
source:
The daughter of the Nakanokouji household, where our story unfolds. A picture of innocence in her sweet lolita frills, but every now and then she'll catch you off guard with a look or comment way beyond her years.
As it turns out, she's hiding something...

[Translated and edited from the official site]
